_: Every number the film shows, one entry each. A card may show a number only if its fact is here. `value` is what was measured, never rounded for the card; `measured` says how, so anyone can measure it again.

facts.what: time for the test suite to run before the change
facts.measured: median of 5 runs of `make test` on the same machine

facts.what: time for the test suite to run after the change
facts.measured: median of 5 runs of `make test -j8` on the same machine
